claims: Seed 20260827 completed 21,600 games: 14,400 competitive and 7,200 solo across optimizing, social, exploratory, and adversarial policies and three explicit sensitivity scenarios.
All modeled games terminated; generated scores stayed within 0/2/4/6/8, and observed sudden death stayed within the sealed three-pair limit.
All six modeled shot-intent families were selected, four different intents led expected score across the six patterns, and no intent was best in every pattern and scenario.
All 7,200 paired rotational mirrors matched exactly; the modeled first-seat decisive win rate was 0.497637, an absolute 0.002363 deviation from parity.
observations.evidence_class: seeded executable event-model plus independent native-agent rules review
limits: The probabilities are explicit assumptions, not measured trajectories, pulse timing, launch force, gate-order adjudication, friction, bounce, physical balance, human skill, or enjoyment.
Generated score-domain validity is not exhaustive physical-action legality, and paired mirror construction partly enforces the tested symmetry.
No human teachability, setup, handling, or meaningful-choice response was observed; Cadet, Raider, and Master thresholds remain provisional.
Thirty-six complete representative traces are preserved, while the static report preserves every aggregate and policy matchup.
observations.release_manual_note: Consolidate seam overlap, fully seated keys, bridge drop-and-6-mm-slide, keeper closure, motion preflight, and blades-at-rest reset.
observations.reproducibility: A second full run from the evaluator source in the evidence root reproduced all four generated report/trace files byte-for-byte.

claims: The sealed full CAD pipeline passed strict fit with zero assembly interference clashes, 24 occurrences, and all six declared motion conditions passing.
Read-only connector and specification reruns passed: 0.30 mm trunnion radial clearance, 0.35 mm axial clearance per side, clear 6 mm bridge unlock travel, and blocked direct seated bridge lift.
Digital blade gaps are 35.0 mm neutral, 12.785 mm nominal closed, and 57.215 mm nominal open; deployed gameplay geometry remains byte-identical to round 1.
observations.evidence_class: sealed CAD geometry, independent connector/spec reruns, and native-agent mechanical inspection
limits: This is digital rigid-geometry evidence only; no physical print, fit, friction, gravity return, oscillation duration, impact retention, seam flatness, rattle, manual fit, or 100-cycle durability was tested.
Blade collision evidence samples plus/minus 45 degrees although the intended stop is plus/minus 50 degrees; the near gate is tested directly and far-gate equivalence relies on mirrored geometry.

claims: All nine exact per-family STLs independently pass the 210 by 210 by 220 mm bed, watertight mesh, and 0.80 mm sampled-thickness gates at the declared 0.4 mm nozzle.

The rejected blade bytes changed: its print envelope is now low-profile 36.998 by 14.0 by 14.7 mm with the authored 90-degree Y rotation and vertical trunnions, rather than upright 14.7 by 14.0 by 36.998 mm.

Independent 45-degree triangle-normal recomputation matches the sealed support report and every exact STL hash; it requires generated support for bridge, blade, magazine, and both trays, and none for both comets, keeper, and seam key.

The recomputation explicitly detects the blade underside, both tray retention lips, and the magazine tongue, directly addressing prior failure declared-print-pose-mismatch and feedback rotate-blade-and-prove-support-needs.
observations.evidence_class: sealed STEP/STL, independent mesh/bed/thickness reruns, source-pose inspection, and independently recomputed support-angle evidence
limits: The triangle-normal audit is not a slicer run or generated toolpath and does not prove support accessibility, removal, or surface quality.
No successful print, bed-origin/brim fit, adhesion, warping, dimensional compensation, layer behavior, physical fit, handling, impact retention, wear, or durability was tested.
The largest tray has only 4 mm total nominal margin on its tight bed axis.
